skip_reason: services unavailable (backend/frontend offline) — static mode only for skipped specialists

findings.title: Traceability enforcer regex excludes all lowercase FR IDs
findings.detail: Regex FR-[A-Z0-9-]+ silently skips all 16 FR-dependency-* requirements. Produces 7 false-positive failures while real requirements go unchecked.

findings.title: GET /api/search route not registered in app.ts — CI tests will fail
findings.detail: FR-dependency-search requires GET /api/search. Test file documents the gap. No searchRouter registered in app.ts. npm test will fail.
findings.fix: Implement Source/Backend/src/routes/search.ts and register in app.ts

findings.title: browserslist <=4.28.6: memory exhaustion + prototype pollution
findings.detail: Critical CVE: prototype pollution enables remote memory exhaustion. Affects Source/Frontend and portal/Frontend.
findings.fix: npm audit fix in Source/Frontend/ and portal/Frontend/

findings.title: form-data 4.0.0–4.0.5: CRLF header injection
findings.detail: Critical CVE: CRLF header injection allows HTTP response splitting. Affects Source/Frontend and portal/Frontend.

findings.title: @grpc/grpc-js 1.14.0–1.14.4: TLS certificate validation bypass
findings.detail: Critical CVE: TLS certificate validation bypass enables MITM attacks. Affects portal/Backend.

findings.title: uuid <11.1.1: buffer overflow in uuid generation
findings.detail: Critical CVE: buffer overflow during UUID generation. Affects all projects with uuid dependency.
findings.fix: Update uuid to >= 11.1.1 across all packages

findings.title: brace-expansion <1.1.17: multiple DoS vectors
findings.detail: Critical CVE: multiple denial-of-service vectors. Affects Source/Backend.

findings.title: body-parser <1.20.9: DoS via compressed requests
findings.detail: Critical CVE: denial-of-service via specially crafted compressed request bodies. Affects Source/Backend and portal/Frontend.
findings.fix: Update body-parser to >= 1.20.9 (or update express to 4.22.3+)

findings.title: Route handlers bypass service layer — direct store calls in workItems.ts, workflow.ts, intake.ts
findings.detail: 10+ direct store.* calls in route handlers violates CLAUDE.md architecture rule. 3 route files affected.
findings.fix: Extract CRUD/state-mutation logic into WorkItemService; delegates from route handlers

findings.title: 74 Specifications/ FRs have 0% source code traceability
findings.detail: FR-001 to FR-069 (plus FR-TMP-*) are entirely untraced. Either stale spec or unstarted work — both invisible to enforcer.
findings.fix: Determine if spec is current truth or superseded. Archive or create plan with traceability.

findings.title: eslint-disable suppresses react-hooks/exhaustive-deps in 2 production hooks
findings.detail: Two eslint-disable-next-line suppressing exhaustive-deps without justification. Risks stale closure bugs.
findings.fix: Audit and either fix dependency arrays or add explicit justification comments

findings.title: OpenTelemetry in portal/Backend: 254 versions behind (6+ major versions)
findings.detail: OpenTelemetry packages are severely outdated. High risk of incompatibility and unpatched vulnerabilities.
findings.fix: Plan incremental major-version migration of OpenTelemetry in portal/Backend

findings.title: express@4.18.2 — 1 major version behind; patch to 4.22.3
findings.detail: express 4.18.2 has known CVEs fixed in 4.22.3. Update to get security patches before major upgrade.

findings.title: nanoid <3.3.16: infinite loop DoS
findings.detail: High CVE: nanoid versions below 3.3.16 can enter infinite loop on crafted input causing DoS.

findings.title: Silent JSON parse failure swallowed in api/client.ts
findings.detail: .catch(() => ({})) swallows JSON parse errors. HTML error responses result in Error with undefined message.
findings.fix: Log parse errors or re-throw with context

findings.title: dependency-linking status table references stale portal/ paths — files actually exist in Source/
findings.detail: Status table marks FR-dependency-frontend-tests as Missing but files exist at Source/Frontend/tests/components/.
findings.fix: Update status table to reflect current Source/ paths; mark FR-dependency-frontend-tests Done

findings.title: Traceability enforcer is single-plan — multi-plan coverage silently drops
findings.detail: Default mode selects only most-recently-modified requirements.md. 19 plans in repo; older plans silently unchecked.
findings.fix: Scan all Plans/*/requirements.md in one pass; aggregate results

escalations.reason: Prototype pollution — security vulnerability requiring dedicated security audit
CRLF header injection — injection class vulnerability per escalation config
TLS certificate validation bypass — cryptographic failure enabling MITM
